verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents its own JavaScript SDK for tracking event data and sending it to destinations, with on-demand plugin loading. Its software-engineering use-case page promotes instrumenting a RudderStack SDK to send standardized data to hundreds of destinations, so building against official SDKs is a documented core capability. missing for 10: evidence of SDK coverage beyond JavaScript (server-side or mobile languages), SDKs for the management/control-plane APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
